description: Change settings of the live interview in progress: recognition language (only within the set chosen at the start; the page reconnects once), auto-answer (when off, answers only on "Answer now"), and one card per question (follow-ups on the same question share one card). Auto-answer and one-card-per-question are supported only by the desktop app overlay. Pass only what should change. Requires the user to have this session open in the browser or desktop app and connected; the page carries it out exactly as if the user clicked the matching button. (Requires the user's sign-in with scope interviews:write.)
name: set_live_interview_options
